C0502.title: Ride-hailing black market uses virtual numbers to register or hijack accounts for low-price proxy ordering
C0502.summary: In April 2024, media reported a “Didi proxy ride-hailing” black market: operators used virtual phone numbers to register ride-hailing accounts, or stole existing accounts, then recruited passengers on social media and trading platforms and offered ride-hailing service below the actual fare to profit from the difference. The report noted that stolen-account remote orders could harm the platform, drivers, and account holders at the same time.
